cases.name: anisotropic_xyz_zyx_wavevector
cases.detail: expected zyx cycles/unit = [.125,-.25,.5], with signed y

cases.name: known_amplitude_power
cases.detail: amplitude 2 cosine has mean square 2; folded conjugates counted once

cases.name: phase_at_known_bin
cases.detail: complex coefficient preserves initial phase on this fixed-origin bin

cases.name: inverse_boxcar
cases.detail: full coefficient inverse reconstructs sampled q, not an underlying continuum

cases.name: parseval_odd_even_(5, 6, 7)
cases.detail: odd/even last-axis folding includes Nyquist only once

cases.name: inverse_windowed_(5, 6, 7)
cases.detail: inverse recovers tapered residual only; zero window edges lose information

cases.name: parseval_odd_even_(6, 7, 8)
cases.detail: odd/even last-axis folding includes Nyquist only once

cases.name: inverse_windowed_(6, 7, 8)
cases.detail: inverse recovers tapered residual only; zero window edges lose information

cases.name: independent_direct_dft
cases.detail: explicit exponential-sum oracle, no FFT implementation in the reference

cases.name: mixed_tone_power_ratio
cases.detail: amplitude ratio 2 gives power ratio 4

cases.name: squared_field_dc
cases.detail: toy q^2 has DC power .25; actual Model A energy has additional terms

cases.name: squared_field_double_frequency
cases.detail: q^2 has twice the q frequency and no sign; not an energy-to-q inverse

cases.name: opposite_sign_same_power
cases.detail: power cannot identify sign/phase

cases.name: destructive_interference
cases.detail: opposite-phase waves cancel; adding their separate powers would be wrong

cases.name: quadrature_interference
cases.detail: equal waves in quadrature have total mean square1, not constructive value2

cases.name: spatial_alias
cases.detail: mode 40 aliases to 24 on 64 samples; no FFT can undo this

cases.name: temporal_alias
cases.detail: 3 cycles/time aliases to 1 at sample dt=.25; spatial and temporal axes differ

cases.name: travel_snapshot_power
cases.detail: traveling wave changes phase, not snapshot power

cases.name: standing_snapshot_power
cases.detail: standing wave at amplitude factor .5 has one quarter the power

cases.name: hann_far_leakage_reduction
cases.detail: power outside x bins6..10; Hann reduces distant leakage but broadens the peak

cases.name: localized_regions
cases.detail: 32-cube regions distinguish wavelengths8 and4; a global spectrum loses location

cases.name: periodic_wrapped_boundary
cases.detail: wrap only when source periodicity is independently established

cases.name: unsupported_inputs_refused
cases.detail: undeclared boundary, nonfinite input, zero spacing, odd/oversized window

cases.name: radial_loses_orientation
cases.detail: axis mode5 and diagonal(3,4) share a radial shell
